event.name: 19 January 2026 · G4 geomagnetic storm onset
event.description: The severe G4 phase first reached at 19:38 UTC on 19 January, as reported by NOAA SWPC. T0 marks this onset, not the storm peak.

observation_source: NASA SPDF hourly OMNI2 archive at Earth. Missing target values retained; Kp/Ap are archived three-hour indices, F10.7 is daily. Bt is the magnitude of the hourly mean GSM vector, matching model training. Retrospective revised observations, not original real-time L1 receipts.
input_source: NASA OMNI2 closed hours strictly before each issue. Current DLinear+PROSWIN speed and DLinear+PROSWIN-speed-assisted LightGBM density models. PROSWIN uses the full author-preprocessed hourly archive, not NRT images; assumed image-slot+1hour availability, with per-lead fallback. Archived observation timestamps label hour starts, matching the existing demo raw-history contract; revised data and assumed image times are not historical live receipts. Kp/Ap enter after three-hour bins close, F10.7 after day end. IMF uses the OMNI training feature definition. Southward IMF/GONG and S10/M10/Y10 forecasts remain unavailable.
